gloss: divine will; destiny; heaven's mandate; natural lifespan

definitions.explanation: one's fate or destiny as determined by heaven or divine forces
the natural span of life given to a person by heaven

examples.japanese: {天命|てんめい}を{全|まっと}うする。
これは{天命|てんめい}だと{思|おも}って{受|う}け{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I accepted it, believing it to be destiny.

examples.japanese: {五十|ごじゅう}にして{天命|てんめい}を{知|し}る。
examples.english: At fifty, one comes to understand heaven's will.
examples.notes: Famous saying from The Analects of Confucius

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{天命|てんめい}を{全|まっと}うして{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away having lived out his natural lifespan.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{天命|てんめい}は{誰|だれ}にも{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: No one knows a person's allotted lifespan.

notes:
{天命|てんめい} refers to destiny as ordained by heaven.

COMPOSITION:
- {天|てん}: Heaven, sky
- {命|めい}: Life, command, destiny

FAMOUS CONFUCIAN SAYING:
{五十|ごじゅう}にして{天命|てんめい}を{知|し}る
"At fifty, one understands heaven's will."
From the Analects of Confucius, describing the stages of life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天命|てんめい}を{全|まっと}うする (to fulfill one's destiny/live out one's natural life)
- {天命|てんめい}を{知|し}る (to understand one's destiny)
- {天命|てんめい}を{待|ま}つ (to await one's fate)
- {天命|てんめい}に{従|したが}う (to follow destiny)

PHILOSOPHICAL CONTEXT:
Rooted in Confucian and traditional East Asian thought where heaven determines one's purpose and lifespan.

RELATED TERMS:
- {運命|うんめい} (fate, destiny - more general)
- {宿命|しゅくめい} (fate, destiny - predetermined)
- {使命|しめい} (mission, calling)
- {寿命|じゅみょう} (lifespan)

REGISTER: Formal/literary. Common in philosophical and formal contexts.
